journeys.name: Central Eastern Italy
journeys.note: Pinpoints the Prospero/Minochelli origin to northern Isernia province, Molise — the key lead for the Italian line, including identifying Angelo's probable second wife.

journeys.name: Munster, Ireland
journeys.note: Matches the Irish lines (Donahue, Regan/Sheehan, Murphy/Burke, Larkin) — West Cork now the prime target for parish-level research.

journeys.name: New Jersey Settlers
subregions: Camden, Gloucester, Northern Salem & Cumberland Counties
Camden, Gloucester, Salem, Cumberland & Atlantic Counties
journeys.note: Directly confirms the Albertson/Pedrick colonial line: Camden/Gloucester counties are the Otter Branch homestead territory; Mercer County matches Edwin S Albertson in Trenton by 1910.

journeys.name: Southwestern Quebec, New York & Vermont French Settlers
subregions: Acton, Les Maskoutains & La Haute-Yamaska French Settlers
Montérégie, Quebec & Northern Vermont French Settlers
journeys.note: Confirms the Drolet French-Canadian line (Philomene Drolet, gen 5) and localizes it to the Montérégie/Yamaska region southeast of Montreal.
